reviewer.prior_context: Reviewer had earlier English-humanizer reference-audit context; this is not a fresh-context or human-reader evaluation.
reviewer.method: Source-to-candidate constraint audit followed by separate editorial judgment; no method attribution inferred.

blinding.read_scope: Only the nine explicit source.txt, A.txt and B.txt files under blind-pairs/support-email, reading-reflection and technical-update were read for this review.
blinding.known_from_task: Sources were described as AI-authored synthetic text; randomized candidates were described as two skill versions. Which label used which version was not disclosed or inferred.

eligibility_definition: A candidate is eligible for scoring when no required fidelity or reader-comprehension repair remains. Eligibility does not certify historical authorship, external factual truth, or detector performance.
